newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares boosted by moderate U.S. CPI.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares boosted by moderate U.S. CPI.

text.p: Austrian shares inched higher on Tuesday after the market received a late boost by the release of lower-than-expected U.S. inflation data which reduced the fear of an imminent rise in U.S. rates.
"Those were really good news," said one trader.
The ATX index of 21 blue chips ended the session 2.37 points or 0.20 percent firmer at 1,166.77. Among its constituents, 11 gainers outweighed nine losers, one issue closed unchanged.
Market participants said the Vienna bourse had further upside potential but that any immediate gains were capped ahead of Friday's expiry of April futures and options contracts.
"The leads have turned more positive again, but the options expiry will keep us locked in a narrow range somewhere between 1,160 and 1,180 points (in the ATX)," said one.
Steel maker Boehler-Uddeholm topped the day's winners, rising 3.11 percent to close at 829 schillings.
Technology group VA Technologie AG rose 35 schillings to 1,700 schillings ahead of the release of final 1996 earnings scheduled for Wednesday.
On the negative side, insurer EA-Generali lost 3.48 percent to fininsh the day at 3,050 schillings.
On the Vienna futures and options exchange, ATX contracts for April delivery rose 8.3 points to 1,171.3 on strong volume of 4,010 contracts.
